limitations: The 1000-schema native panels are LL-supported regression samples, not a full-population publication.
JSB dynamic middle quantiles regress modestly; the change is retained for the large JS gain and stable prioritized tails/static guards.
Initial static build P90 rose; the selected and independent full-panel repetitions are retained rather than replacing that observation.
Fresh production JS P100 remains above llguidance; whole-distribution parity is not achieved.
CFA mask_i+commit_i and native commit_i-to-mask_i+1 metrics are different and are never pooled.
Cache-disabled walker probes and production-cache CFA/native results are different protocols and are reported separately.
Stabilized extrema are maxima over per-position minima; every raw maximum remains a separate statistic.
llguidance uses a different JavaScript grammar; cross-engine mask equality is not asserted.
Results are measured on this Mac with equal build/runtime settings; no cross-machine performance guarantee is claimed.
